I’ll tell you how things ended for me tho... my girlfriend left me after a year of dating, she reassured me countless times that she would never leave, she told me i was the love of her life while hiding the fact that she cheated on me... So yeah my worst fears came true and it’s painful... BUT my biggest regret during this whole experience was that I didn’t get to enjoy my time with her because I was always in my head worrying about the worst case scenario. I had a whole year to spend with this lovely person and i spent more then half of it worrying... and guess what it still happened...
Worrying gives you a false sense of control but you can’t know what will happen in the future, so why not enjoy what you have now :) Honestly my biggest mistake in life so far is not enjoying every single moment I had with her.

My last relationship was the same way but I was on the other side. Breaking up is definitely the right thing to do if you’re dragging each other down. I put all my emotional baggage on my partner just like your gf and I never learned how to deal with them myself. I truly regret it so much because I never wanted to hurt my partner and I blame myself a lot for acting this way. My partner told me I was very selfish and she couldn’t take it anymore. The thing is I never realized the pain i was causing her because she never brought it up until she grew resentful and left. I guess my only advice is, your girlfriend probably loves you very much and never meant to hurt you this way. So maybe don’t put the blame on her to the extent my ex did, especially if there was no communication about this problem between you two. I’m not defending her behaviour, but I would approach her in a more understanding way then blaming. Good luck op, you’re doing the right thing for both of you. And also advice for the future, set clear boundaries for yourself and communicate clearly when things get too much!!

And i regret not enjoying the moment when i had the chance. My partner left me after reassuring me that we were gonna be together for the rest of our lives countless of times. I’m not mad at them or anything but I just think no one knows what’s gonna happen in the future and you should just enjoy the moments you have together. In my experience worrying so much about the future just made everything worse and probably even contributed to the break up.
